profile_text.body:
Hugging Face is a for-profit AI company founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York, NY. The company describes itself as advancing and democratizing artificial intelligence through open source and open science, positioning itself as a community platform for AI development.

The company's primary products are the Hugging Face Hub, a repository where developers can discover, share, and deploy machine learning models, and Hugging Face Transformers, an open-source library for working with those models that also supports inference. Both products are considered relevant to AI supply-chain tracking and AI bill of materials concerns, with the Hub incorporating model card verification and security scanning capabilities.

The held facts show a New York law exposure profile with 185 associated entries, and Hugging Face maintains a registered MCP server, co.huggingface/hf-mcp-server, described as providing connectivity to the Hugging Face Hub and to Gradio AI applications. No litigation cases are recorded in the current data.
